metadata.article_title: Public servant concerned in sale not to purchase or bid for property

article.title: Public servant concerned in sale not to purchase or bid for property
article.content: A public servant having any duty to perform in connection with the sale of any property under this Sanhita shall not purchase or bid for the property.
article.html:
527Public servant concerned in sale not to purchase or bid for property

Section 527 · Chapter XXXIX

A public servant having any duty to perform in connection with the sale of any property under this Sanhita shall not purchase or bid for the property.
